title: dfdu dupes --format json
description: Groups of files with identical contents below a directory, the most space to free first. Sizes are bytes; paths as in scan.v1.json. Fields may be added without changing schema_version.

min_size.description: Files smaller than this were not compared.

compared.description: Files that shared their size with another and were read.

skipped.description: Files left out: unreadable, or changed since the scan.

wasted.description: The sum of every group's wasted.
What deleting all copies but one would free at most: APFS clones share their data, and a file with other names (hard links) frees nothing.

clones.description: Every copy is an APFS clone of the others: deleting copies frees nothing.

private.description: Bytes no other file shares (APFS only): what deleting this file frees.

links.description: Other names of this file in the scan (hard links).
